description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_택배신청 저장 서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 우편소포에 대한 신청과 접수완료, 취소 처리 기능을 제공하는 OPEN API 서비스 입니다. ㅇ 출력하는 항목(사용자가 응답 받게 되는 데이터): 신청자이름, 우편번호, 전화번호, 휴대전화, 수령자이름, 중량, 부피, 내용물, 내용품코드, 배송특이사항, 이메일, 방문접수 우체국, 요금부담여부, 접수결과... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 정보/통신, 소프트웨어, 인터넷 S/W, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2021-08-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
